meta.narrative_direction: 부정형 — 중국 기준. 조항으로 24개국을 쥐고 있던 판이 회수 실패·계약 파기·자산 상실로 닫히는 서사(verified-data 3절: 2024년 순수취 340억 달러, 니제르 48시간 추방, 에콰도르 4억 달러 배상 합의)라 세트의 착지는 부정형이다. 다만 조항이 실제로 작동하던 1~5번 장면은 중국이 아직 쥐고 있는 국면이므로 direction을 '혼합'으로 두어 중국 국기는 온전·선명(긍정형)·채무국 국기는 그늘과 탁한 색(부정형)으로 갈라 배치했고, 6~9번에서 중국 국기를 그을리고 찢어 부정형으로 전환한다. 태극기는 등장하지 않는다(한국은 본문 무대가 아님).

meta.prompt_prefix: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge as a single full-bleed image — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is the same continuous scene rendered dark, smoky and free of detail so overlay text stays readable, while all faces, flags, weapons and key objects sit entirely within the upper five-eighths. Anything held or carried sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. photoreal current-affairs broadcast composite: every person, flag and location is a real photograph, sharp and true to life — faces keep real skin texture, pores, stray hair and natural shadow, and fabric keeps a visible weave. Over that photographic base sit broadcast graphic treatments: a bold colour field, cracked-glass shards, torn and scorched edges, a hard vignette, heavy atmospheric haze and fire glow. Dramatic hard lighting, one dominant colour drowning the frame, every part of the upper five-eighths packed edge to edge with elements and no empty space, cinematic wide-angle, very high contrast. NOT an oil painting, NOT brushwork or impasto, NOT a matte painting, NOT anime, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3d render
meta.prompt_suffix: no title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no lower-third news banner, no watermark. Apart from the Korean Hangul labels and numerals named above — which must be rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms — do not invent any other words or letterforms anywhere in the image.
meta.negative_prompt: oil painting, brushwork, impasto, painterly, matte painting, illustration, anime, 3d render, cartoon, glowing eyes, letterbox bars, empty grey panel, rising-sun flag, Korean taegukgi damaged

thumbnails.concept_ko: 2016년 5월 23일, 계약 조건이 유출되자 중국국가개발은행이 에콰도르에 '누가 흘렸는지 색출하라'는 서한을 보낸 장면(verified-data 장면·일화). 채권자가 채무국 내부 색출을 지시했다는 상식 밖 그림 하나로 스크롤을 멈춘다. 방향 판정 — 중국은 아직 쥐고 있는 국면이라 오성홍기를 온전·선명(긍정형)으로, 에콰도르는 그늘과 탁한 색(부정형)으로 갈라 배치했다. 좌우 50:50이 아니라 중국이 화면 3분의 2를 먹는 비대칭(003 실패 회피).
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping's face spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Xi Jinping (President of China) stands directly in front of the camera at eye level in a dim state lending office and occupies the left two thirds of the frame — brow flat and untroubled, eyelids lowered in cold calculation, jaw set, one corner of the mouth tucked slightly inward, looking straight out at the viewer. One hand rests flat on a red-stamped letter he has just pushed across a dark lacquered desk toward the camera. Immediately behind him an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — fills the wall from top to bottom in real woven fabric with a visible weave and deep folds, saturated and crisply lit. Crushed into the remaining right third and pushed into shadow hangs an Ecuadorian flag — a horizontal yellow band of double width above blue above red — dull, grimy, sun-bleached and half swallowed by black smoke. A hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto the letter and forces the eye to it. The letter's cover carries the Korean Hangul label "기밀유지" printed large and crisp; every other line on the page is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cracked-glass shards radiate across the window behind him, and beyond the glass an oil-field flare burns orange, its raking firelight cutting across his cheek while the rest of the room drowns in deep red and black.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 교차 디폴트가 현실에서 작동한 순간 — 아르헨티나가 산타크루스 수력댐을 환경 사유로 되돌리려 하자 중국국가개발은행이 아무 상관 없는 벨그라노 화물철도 대출 20억 달러를 취소하겠다고 통보한 장면. 댐과 열차를 한 줄로 묶은 붉은 쇠사슬로 '서류상 한 줄'을 물리화했다. 방향 판정 — 중국은 온전한 국기와 여유 표정(긍정형), 아르헨티나는 그늘·정지·낭패(부정형).
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping's face spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Xi Jinping (President of China) fills the left two thirds of the frame at eye level, chin lifted, one eyebrow raised a fraction, lips closed in a flat unbothered line, eyes fixed straight on the viewer with no urgency at all; no hands in frame. An enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — hangs behind him in heavy woven fabric, taut in hard wind, saturated and brightly lit. Behind and below him, in the middle ground, a half-built concrete hydroelectric dam wall and a stopped freight train stand joined by one thick red chain rendered as a broadcast graphic, the chain running from the dam's spillway to the locomotive's coupler. Squeezed into the right edge, small and shadowed, stands Javier Milei (President of Argentina) with his brow furrowed deep, eyes cast down and unfocused, one palm pressed to his forehead, and behind him an Argentine flag — horizontal light blue, white and light blue bands with a golden sun face in the centre — hangs slack, desaturated and soot-stained. A red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto the chain link at the centre. A steel shipping container beside the locomotive carries the Korean Hangul label "교차 담보" stencilled large and crisp on its side; all other stencilling on the container is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Black smoke and orange flare light pack every gap between dam, train and figures.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 나이지리아 하원이 2018년 철도 대출 계약서에서 제8조 1항(주권면제 철회 불가능 포기)을 발견한 순간. 조항이 '나라의 면제권'을 종이 한 줄로 가져간다는 이 영상의 명제를 가장 직접 보여준다. 방향 판정 — 화면 무대는 중국(오성홍기가 배경 절반 이상)이지만 당한 쪽 얼굴을 세워 조항의 실감을 만든다: 나이지리아 부정형, 중국 국기는 온전(긍정형)이라 혼합. 시진핑 없이 채무국 원수만 세워 9장의 얼굴 구성을 벌렸다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the face of the nearest figure spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Bola Tinubu (President of Nigeria) stands at eye level filling the right half of the frame inside a dark parliamentary chamber, looking straight into the camera — eyes stretched wide, nostrils flared, lower lip caught under his teeth, the muscles at his jaw hinge standing out, one hand flat on an open loan contract lying on the bench rail in front of him. An enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — fills the entire left half and the whole wall behind him in heavy woven fabric, saturated, crisply lit and completely intact, dwarfing a narrow Nigerian flag — three vertical bands of green, white, green — that hangs shadowed and dust-dulled at the far right edge. A hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto a single line of the open contract. The contract's cover page carries the Korean Hangul label "제8조" printed large and crisp; every other line of the document is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Rows of empty dark chamber seats recede behind him, cracked-glass shards spread across the high window, and heavy amber haze and drifting smoke fill every gap so no part of the frame is empty.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 3절 '계약서 100장에 똑같이 박힌 한 줄'을 그대로 이행하는 컷. AidData가 입수한 24개국 100건의 계약서를 부채꼴로 펼쳐 같은 자리에 같은 붉은 줄이 그어진 것을 보여준다 — 반복 자체가 증거다. 방향 판정 — 조항 설계가 완성된 국면이라 중국은 온전한 국기와 만족 표정(긍정형), 배경 채무국 국기들은 그늘(부정형)이라 혼합.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping's face spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Xi Jinping (President of China) stands at eye level filling the right third of the frame, eyes narrowed to slits, the corners of his mouth pressed down as if holding back satisfaction, chin slightly tucked, looking straight at the viewer; his right hand presses a red seal down onto the topmost page of a huge fan of loan contracts spread across the desk in front of him. The stack fans out in a wide arc that fills the left two thirds of the upper frame, a hundred identical printed pages, and on every single page the same single line sits at the same position highlighted in hard red, repeating across the whole fan. An enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — fills the entire wall behind in heavy woven fabric with deep folds, saturated and crisply lit. Ranked behind it in the far shadowed background hang a dozen small dulled national flags of borrowing states, desaturated and grimy, half lost in black haze. A red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto the repeated line on the nearest page. The topmost cover carries the Korean Hangul label "대출 계약서" printed large and crisp; every other line on every page is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cracked-glass shards and hard vignette press in at the edges, warm red light drowning the frame.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 1절 인용구 '누가 흘렸는지 밝혀내라'를 이행하는 컷 — 빚진 나라가 자기 빚의 조건을 국민에게 알렸다는 이유로 채권자에게 내부 색출을 지시받은 자리. 취조등 같은 붉은 상단광 아래 에콰도르 원수를 정면에 세워 '지시받는 쪽'의 온도를 만든다. 방향 판정 — 에콰도르는 압박당하는 부정형, 벽을 덮은 중국 국기는 온전·선명(긍정형)이라 혼합.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the face of the nearest figure spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Daniel Noboa (President of Ecuador) stands at eye level filling the centre-left of the frame in a windowless room, looking straight into the camera — jaw clamped, lips pressed into one hard line, eyes locked forward and rimmed red, a single vertical crease between his brows, no hands in frame. A harsh interrogation-style light falls from above and carves his face out of the dark. Filling the entire right half and running behind him wall to wall hangs an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — in heavy woven fabric, taut, saturated and crisply lit, while a small Ecuadorian flag — a horizontal yellow band of double width above blue above red — hangs shadowed, dull and soot-marked at the far left edge. On the table in front of him lie a red-stamped letter and a stack of personnel files, and a hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto the letter's signature block. The letter's cover carries the Korean Hangul label "기밀 위반" printed large and crisp; every other line on the letter and every name on the files is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cracked-glass shards spread across the dark wall behind, orange fire glow bleeds in from a doorway, and dense haze packs every remaining gap.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 부제 '하나씩 뒤집히는 장부'의 첫 이행 컷 — 2025년 3월 니제르 군사정부가 CNPC·송유관회사·정유소의 중국인 대표 3명에게 48시간 출국을 통보한 사건. 여기서 세트의 방향이 전환된다. 방향 판정 — 니제르는 긍정형(온전·선명한 국기, 결기 있는 표정, 정렬된 제복 대열), 중국은 부정형(가장자리가 타 들어간 오성홍기)으로 갈라 배치. 인물은 국가원수와 제복 집단만 쓰고 무명 민간인을 세우지 않았다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the face of the nearest figure spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Abdourahamane Tiani (Head of State of Niger) stands at eye level filling the left half of the frame in military uniform, chin lifted, eyes narrowed with certainty, mouth set in a tight satisfied line, looking straight at the viewer; his hand holds out a single typed notice at mid height. Behind him an enormous Nigerien flag — horizontal orange, white and green bands with an orange disc in the centre — flies large and taut in hard wind, deep rippling folds, vivid and crisply lit by a rising dawn light, and a column of Nigerien soldiers recedes behind him in ranks, each one progressively smaller and hazier, rifles slung. Filling the right side of the frame, an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — hangs with its edges charred black and torn into ragged strips, flame eating along the fabric, soot staining the folds, its stars still fully legible. Between them rise the pipe racks and burn stack of an oil refinery, orange flame splitting the frame vertically. A hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto the notice in his hand. The notice carries the Korean Hangul label "출국 통보" printed large and crisp; every other line on it is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 돈을 빌려준 쪽이 화면을 혼자 차지한 채 겁먹고 있다. [남김] ① 좌우 분할 없이 중국 쪽이 화면 단독 지배 ② 붉은 원+화살표로 핵심 오브젝트 강제 지목 ③ 하단 3/8을 어둡게 이어 텍스트 밴드 자리로 비움(앵커의 하단 35~40% 2줄 계층형 텍스트 위치 계승) ④ 정면 아이레벨, 피사체가 관객 쪽을 본다. [바꿈] ① 핵심 피사체(빈 크레인 조종석 → 도장 찍힌 계약서 뭉치) ② 배경(뿌연 회색 공사장 → 어두운 집무실과 서류철 벽) ③ 부속 요소(짐 싸서 걸어 나가는 인물 행렬 → 빈 의자 하나). 인물은 시진핑으로 3장 고정 — [모순]을 무명 관료로 바꿔 읽으면 '돈을 빌려준 쪽'이라는 주어가 증발하므로 인물은 [바꿈] 대상이 아니다. 거리감은 셋 중 가장 넓은 컷. 계승 3장 중 우리 쪽 얼굴 조항은 한국이 등장하지 않는 제3국 서사라 미적용(정세형 규칙 '적용 범위' 조항).
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping's face spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Wide shot of a dark state office. Xi Jinping (President of China) alone dominates the frame at eye level, no second country beside him, staring straight out at the viewer — eyes stretched wide with the whites showing, lower jaw slack and mouth fallen open, eyebrows driven up into deep forehead lines, shoulders sunk, no hands in frame. Behind and around him an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — covers the whole wall in heavy woven fabric, its edges charred black and torn into ragged strips, soot staining the folds, colour desaturated and grimy, the stars still fully legible. To his left on a dark lacquered desk sits a thick stack of loan contracts weighed down by a red seal, and a hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto that stack and forces the eye to it. One empty chair stands pushed back from the desk, its seat still angled away. Floor-to-ceiling shelves of document binders recede into shadow behind. The top binder spine carries the Korean Hangul label "비공개" printed large and crisp; every other spine and every line on the contracts is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cracked-glass shards run across the window, orange fire glow rakes in from the left, black haze packs every gap.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 돈을 빌려준 쪽이 화면을 혼자 차지한 채 겁먹고 있다. [남김] 7번과 동일한 4개(단독 지배 / 붉은 원+화살표 지목 / 하단 3/8 텍스트 자리 / 정면 아이레벨 응시). [바꿈] ① 핵심 피사체(빈 크레인 조종석 → 상환 장부와 잔액이 멈춘 계좌 단말) ② 광원·색온도(뿌연 회색 주광 → 아래에서 치솟는 화염이 얼굴을 붉게 때리는 하부 키라이트) ③ 손동작(짐 지고 걸어 나가는 행렬 → 관자놀이를 짚은 반사 동작, 범주 A). 근거는 verified-data 3-3절 — 원금을 안 깎다가 결국 못 받게 된 국면. 인물은 시진핑 고정, 거리감은 가슴 위.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping's face spans the top fifty-five to sixty percent of the frame height, the top of his head touching the upper edge. Chest-up shot. Xi Jinping (President of China) alone fills the frame at eye level, no second country in the picture, eyes turned to the viewer from under lowered lids, deep horizontal creases cut across his forehead, mouth pulled down at both corners, two fingers pressed hard against his temple in a reflex he did not intend. A wall of flame burns low in front of him out of frame and throws hard orange key light up onto his face from below while the rest of the room stays black. Filling the whole background an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — hangs with burn holes eaten through the fabric and its lower edge charred into ragged strips, colours dull and smoke-stained, the stars still legible. On the desk under his elbow lies an open repayment ledger beside a bank terminal whose balance line has stopped, and a hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto that stopped balance line. The ledger's cover carries the Korean Hangul label "미상환" printed large and crisp; every entry line inside the ledger and on the terminal is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cracked-glass shards spread from the desk edge outward, thick black smoke fills every remaining gap of the upper frame.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 돈을 빌려준 쪽이 화면을 혼자 차지한 채 겁먹고 있다. [남김] 7·8번과 동일한 4개(단독 지배 / 붉은 원+화살표 지목 / 하단 3/8 텍스트 자리 / 정면 아이레벨 응시). [바꿈] ① 핵심 피사체(빈 크레인 조종석 → 반으로 찢겨 나가는 계약서 한 장) ② 장소(공사장 → 창밖으로 유전 플레어가 보이는 밤의 회의실) ③ 주변 소품(떠나는 인물 행렬 → 바닥에 엎어진 도장과 번진 붉은 인주). 확정 제목 부제 '하나씩 뒤집히는 장부'의 착지 컷 — 계약을 뒤집은 쪽 얼굴을 넣으면 [남김]①(중국 단독 지배)이 깨지므로 반격은 찢기는 종이로만 표현했다. 인물은 시진핑 고정, 거리감은 얼굴 중심으로 가장 좁게.

Tight face-centred shot at eye level. Xi Jinping (President of China) alone occupies the frame, staring straight into the camera — both lips rolled inward and bitten shut, nostrils flared, a tendon standing out on the side of his neck, eyes fixed forward and unblinking, no hands in frame. Directly beside his cheek a single loan contract page is caught mid-tear, ripped clean through the middle, the torn fibres lit orange, and a hard red broadcast-graphic circle with an arrow clamps onto that tear. Filling the entire background an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — hangs across the conference-room wall with its edges charred black and eaten into ragged strips, soot in every fold, colour dull and grimy, the stars still legible. Through the tall window behind him an oil-field flare burns in the night, its raking orange light cutting across half his face. A toppled red seal lies on the table with its ink smeared in a wide red streak. The torn page's header carries the Korean Hangul label "계약 해지" printed large and crisp; every other line on the page is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cracked-glass shards fan out across the window, heavy smoke haze packs every gap.
